mapper.sql: t.id, t.agent_id, t.visitor_id, t.content, t.last_msg_id, t.add_time, t.update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO xxl_ai_memory ( agent_id, visitor_id, content, last_msg_id, add_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{agentId}, #{visitorId}, #{content}, #{lastMsgId}, NOW(), NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE content = VALUES(content), last_msg_id = VALUES(last_msg_id), update_time = NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE xxl_ai_memory AS t JOIN xxl_ai_agent AS a ON a.id = t.agent_id SET t.content = #{content}, t.update_time = NOW() WHERE t.id = #{id} AND a.space_id = #{spaceId}
